describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background. Its body, head, and limbs are covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the lower legs and lighter tan around the muzzle and cheeks, giving the overall appearance of a bear. Fused to its dorsal side from just behind the neck to the rump is a large, glossy, hard, dark reddish-brown segmented carapace resembling a beetle's exoskeleton, with a smooth domed shield over the shoulders and overlapping ridged segments behind it. A single large, glossy blackish-brown curved horn with notches along its inner edge rises from the center of the forehead and arches upward and backward. The animal stands on four thick legs with clawed paws, and a very short furry tail is visible at the rear beneath the carapace.

describe.description: A large four-legged creature with the body, head, fur, legs and feet of a brown bear, shown in side view facing right. Its entire back from behind the neck to the rump is covered by a dark reddish-brown glossy segmented beetle carapace with a larger shield-like section over the shoulders. A single long glossy black curved beetle horn with notches on its inner edge grows from the top of its forehead. A row of oval dark holes runs along its flank just below the edge of the shell. It has a small furry stub tail at the rear.
